tasks.label: Verify broadcast reduction edge cases
tasks.command:
cd /home/karthick/projects/aiTest && .venv/bin/python -c "
import numpy as np
from aqua.engine.ops import reduceGradToShape
def reference(g, in_shape):
    # align in_shape to the trailing axes of g.shape (numpy broadcasting rule)
    padded = (1,)*(g.ndim-len(in_shape)) + tuple(in_shape)
    ref = np.zeros(in_shape)
    for idx in np.ndindex(g.shape):
        b = tuple(0 if padded[k]==1 and g.shape[k]>1 else idx[k] for k in range(g.ndim))[-len(in_shape):]
        ref[b] += g[idx]
    return ref
cases = [((4,3,5),(3,5)), ((4,3,5),(5,)), ((4,3,5),(1,5)), ((4,3,5),(3,1)), ((4,3),(3,)), ((4,3),(1,)), ((4,3,5),(3,5,1)), ((4,3,5),(1,1,5))]
for out_shape, in_shape in cases:
    g = np.random.default_rng(0).normal(size=out_shape)
    r = reduceGradToShape(g, in_shape)
    ref = reference(g, in_shape)
    print(f'{str(out_shape):<12} <- {str(in_shape):<10} shape={str(r.shape):<10} correct={np.allclose(r, ref)}')
"
